description: An abstract base class implementation for all LiveCommand types, providing common functionality such as resource path, headers, type, JSON serialization, and equality methods.

classes.name: AbstractLiveCommand
classes.description: An abstract base implementation for all LiveCommand types, facilitating common operations and ensuring immutability.

methods.name: AbstractLiveCommand
methods.description: Constructor that wraps a Command object, ensuring it is not null.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the resource path associated with the command.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the manifest string for the command.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the DittoHeaders associated with the command.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the command.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the command to a JsonObject using the provided schema version and predicate.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on class type and wrapped command.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on the wrapped command.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the command.
